purpose: Acquire and preserve a complete unmodified real symmetric microwave finite-element matrix for subsequent industrial solver validation. Acquisition and matrix checks only; no eigensolver acceptance or performance claim.

attribution.original_research_title: GPU Acceleration of Multilevel Solvers for Analysis of Microwave Components With Finite Element Method
attribution.original_research_citation_verified_at_a: IEEE Microwave and Wireless Components Letters 21(1), pp. 1-3, January 2011
attribution.citation_discrepancy: Original Matrix Market and collection metadata say volume 20 no.12 December 2010. The author university lists volume 21 no.1 January 2011. Raw original header retained unchanged; DOI and authors agree.

license_evidence.scope: SuiteSparse collection matrices. Retain the original archive and original Matrix Market author header and disclose the format conversion.
license_evidence.boundary: License is stated by the collection maintainer. Current TAMU and legacy UF pages are one collection lineage, not independent institutional validation. Hashes are locally computed over TLS-acquired files, not upstream signed checksums.

official_sources.role: Current collection metadata: 589446 square, 21758924 full nonzeros, real symmetric, not positive definite, ninth-order microwave combline filter.
Original official UF metadata and download mirror; same collection lineage.
Collection CC-BY-4.0 license and preservation/citation requirements.
Author university independently identifies the research paper and corrected 2011 bibliographic citation; it does not independently authenticate this archive or its numeric coefficients.

acquisition.transport: curl HTTPS only; TLS verification enabled; one Range resume after early disconnect
acquisition.description: Format conversion only: original Matrix Market preserved, declared symmetric storage reconstructed, duplicate entries combined, CSR indices sorted. No coefficient edits, symmetrization, subsetting or reference answers.
acquisition.citation: Davis and Hu (2011), doi:10.1145/2049662.2049663; Kolodziej et al. (2019), doi:10.21105/joss.01244; retain the original Matrix Market header for author citations.

% UF Sparse Matrix Collection, Tim Davis

% kind: electromagnetics problem
% notes:
% High order vector finite element method in electromagnetics
% The matrices came from analysis of a 9-th order microwave
% combline filter with second order (LT\QN) vector finite elements
% with different mesh quality. The matrices were used as an
% example in our paper [1].
% gsm_106857 - real symmetric matrix (589446 x 589446) and
%     21758924 nonzero elements. First 98577 unknowns corresponds
%     to lowest level (CT\LN) base functions.
% All matrices are sparse and come with right-hand-sides.
% [1] GPU Acceleration of Multilevel Solvers for Analysis of
% Microwave Components with Finite Element Method, A. Dziekonski,
% A. Lamecki, A., and M. Mrozowski, M., IEEE Microwave and
% Wireless Components Letters, vol 20, number 12,
transformations: Original compressed archive and Matrix Market are preserved byte-for-byte; only the exact expected regular .mtx archive member is copied.
Matrix Market real symmetric triangular storage (11174185 entries) is reconstructed as specified by the format to the complete 21758924-entry matrix.

CSR format conversion, duplicate combination and index sorting only. No coefficient editing, symmetrization by averaging, real-part extraction, cropping, principal submatrix selection or reference answer generation.

retrieval_and_conversion_tests.scope: Offline mocked network boundary and real small Matrix Market conversion: official mirror fallback after connection failure and partial read, header/stream byte budgets, pre-request HTTPS downgrade refusal, exact regular-member copying, duplicate/symlink/budget rejection, original preservation, shape/nnz validation and no overwrite.

resource_interpretation.warning: Ordering statistics are published estimates, not a measured eigensolver run. Sparse direct-factorization fill can exceed the raw CSR storage by a large factor; factorization memory and shifted-system performance have not been validated on this host.

numerical_acceptance.claim_boundary: Real microwave input acquisition and exact Hermitian structure validation are complete. No eigenpair result or industrial performance score is asserted in this evidence file.
